title: Viral Nucleic Acid Isolation from Oral and Nasal Swabs
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Attach Pipettes to OT‑2
steps.instruction: Ensure both the P20 single‑channel and P300 multi‑channel pipettes are securely mounted on the OT‑2 robot.

steps.title: Set Protocol Parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, specify the number of columns of samples (must be a multiple of 8) and input any sample‑and‑lysis settings required for the run.

steps.title: Download Protocol File
steps.instruction: Click “Download your protocol” to obtain the JSON protocol file for this nucleic‑acid extraction.

steps.title: Upload Protocol to OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, select “Upload protocol” and load the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange Deck According to Map
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the deck as shown in the protocol deck map: a Kingfisher 96‑well deep‑well plate on the magnetic module, a 96‑well PCR full‑skirt plate, tip racks for 20 µL and 200 µL tips, and any reservoirs.

steps.title: Calibrate Labware and Pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, run calibration for the tip racks, deep‑well plate, PCR plate, and both pipettes following the on‑screen prompts.

steps.title: Load Samples into Deep‑Well Plate
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL of each oral or nasal swab sample into the corresponding well of the Kingfisher deep‑well plate that sits on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add Lysis Buffer and Beads
steps.instruction: Add the MagBio CTL lysis buffer and MAG‑S1 particle beads (suspended in 100 % isopropanol) to each well containing the sample, mixing as required.

steps.title: Perform Ethanol Washes
steps.instruction: Conduct two sequential washes of the magnetic beads with ethanol, allowing the beads to remain on the magnetic module between washes.

steps.title: Elute Nucleic Acid to PCR Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate from each well to the corresponding well of a full‑skirted 96‑well PCR plate and add the appropriate volume of PCR master‑mix for downstream amplification.

steps.title: Run Protocol on OT‑2
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to execute the automated extraction steps as programmed.
